title: pvResourcePiecewiseFunction
body:
## pvResourcePiecewiseFunction

Typed piecewise-function resource (vtkPiecewiseFunction) that maps a data value to a single number, normally opacity from 0 to 1, through control points. Its main use is the ScalarOpacityFunction input of pvResourcePVLookupTable, where it defines how transparent each data value is. It produces no dataset and can be shared by several lookup tables.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Points positions are data values and are not rescaled automatically; place them across your array's range.
- Exercised by examples/schemaxis/paraview-resources.json (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json); other settings are unverified.

Native constructor: `PiecewiseFunction`. Identity: `piecewise_functions/PiecewiseFunction`. Role: `resource`. Output kinds: `["piecewise-function"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AllowDuplicateScalars` | Whether two control points may share the same x value. True keeps both, giving a vertical step in opacity at that value; false makes the later point replace the earlier one. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Points` | Control points as a flat list of [x, y, midpoint, sharpness] groups: x is the data value, y the function value there (usually opacity 0 to 1), midpoint (0 to 1) where between this point and the next the value is halfway, and sharpness from 0 (linear) to 1 (step). Give groups in increasing x. Complete tuples of 4 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `ScalarRangeInitialized` | Set to 1 to indicate that the scalar range has been initialized. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseLogScale` | When true, the position between two control points is measured on a log10 scale of the data value, so the function changes evenly per decade rather than per unit. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "process-local typed native resource",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvResourcePiecewiseFunction"
}
```
